dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: Bookings completed end to end
highlights.summary: Eligible callers were offered live availability, could choose a suitable slot and received a clear confirmation without waiting for the pro shop.
highlights.quote: “We have 2:00, 2:10 and 2:20 PM available.” After the caller chose 2:00 PM: “You are all set for Tuesday, July 28 at 2:00 PM for 3 players.”

highlights.title: Eligibility checks protected booking rules
highlights.summary: When no eligible account was associated with the caller’s number, SpeakSport did not create a booking and instead offered the correct human hand-off.
highlights.quote: “I don’t see an active eligible account associated with your phone number, so I can’t book the tee time directly. Would you like me to transfer you to the pro shop?”

highlights.title: Routine questions resolved immediately
highlights.summary: Straightforward questions were answered in the call, preserving staff time while giving golfers an immediate, useful response.
highlights.quote: Caller: “Can you give me the rate for league play?” SpeakSport: “The rate is $55 for 18 holes and $45 for 9 holes or twilight league play.”

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Eligibility is checked before a booking is created, helping ensure that callers who are not entitled to book are routed to the right team instead.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Radrick Farms to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep answers and operating information current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of demand, outcomes and opportunities to improve the caller journey.
